title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Koenigsegg Gemera
description:
The Koenigsegg Gemera was revealed in March twenty twenty with a tiny three-cylinder engine making six hundred horsepower. Six years later, as production finally began, that engine was gone from the order book. Two things most people do not know about the Gemera: how that engine worked, and how much the car changed on the way to production. Every figure here is sourced. We used Wikipedia's pages on the Gemera, the Regera and Koenigsegg, a March twenty twenty-six report on AOL, Motor1, InsideHook, SlashGear and Jalopnik. The sources disagree on power, weight and motor counts in several places. We show the disagreements. Our own arithmetic is labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
